info.name: Financing API
info.description:
Requests for the financing application pipeline.

1. Start the stack (`docker compose up`) and import the "Financing API - Local" environment, or keep the collection defaults.
2. Send any request: a bearer token is fetched automatically with the demo client credentials.
3. "Applications" walks through submit → idempotent replay → status → audit trail.
4. "Verification scenarios" covers every mocked gateway behaviour and checks the decision; run the folder with the Collection Runner.

Scenario digits: Nafath = last digit of nationalId, SIMAH = second-to-last digit of nationalId, Wathiq = last digit of crNumber. See GET /mock/scenarios.
